stackDivergence.rationale: Task107 implements original configmgr Modifications prefix-tree add/remove/empty/getRoot and the inline ENABLE_DCONF clear value body, plus Additions path-list type responsibility. Actual copied OUString keys/content uniqueness/stable child and root refs use existing ConfigEntry/LengthContentsCompare/SortedVector, without Boost/hash/refcount/allocator/finalizer wrappers. Native unordered bucket/iteration permutation/iterator-address/ABI is excluded; writemodfile explicitly sorts child entries, while other callback order effects remain unverified. ModificationsNode and Modifications.Node erase original nested-type syntax; native const borrowing is the caller contract. Preserve prefix dominance, subtree replacement, duplicate identity and recursive pruning. Last-root removal can recurse into forbidden empty path (CALC-092); preserve algorithm without a root-stop fix, and do not execute/certify undefined native release behavior. Clear represents its original value body without a DConf backend or build-conditioned API availability parity. Additions uses native arrays; implicit C++ vector-copy/ABI semantics are not certified and real consumers must own value copies. Original source-backed valid histories, no compiled differential/fullQA/memory experiment or new C++ generator. Actual Data/Set/Property/XML/backend/settings/default/document/grid/ODS pipeline remains pending. Nextfull111 requested pause after relevant repairs; no Writer-only repair.
